name: Filled Pure Sample Jar
summary: A Filled Pure Sample Jar contains an uncorrupted specimen of primordial ooze gathered from the remote wilds. It serves as crucial baseline data for the gnome scholar Laris Geardawdle in Ironforge, who is studying how environmental corruption alters living matter.

sections.title: A Search for Uncorrupted Slime
sections.body: In his study of oozes across Azeroth, the gnomish researcher Laris Geardawdle discovered a troubling phenomenon: these amorphous creatures absorb and reflect the magical and environmental corruption of their habitats. After cataloging the tainted slimes of Felwood, Laris determined that deciphering the nature of the rot required a control group. A Filled Pure Sample Jar holds ooze harvested from pristine, untainted wilderness—such as the primordial ecology of Un'Goro Crater—offering scholars an unaltered specimen to compare against diseased and corrupted strains.

sections.title: Primordial Ecology
sections.body: Because oozes are extraordinarily malleable organisms, true 'pure' samples cannot be collected near modern civilization, demonic blights, or necromantic fallout. The glutinous oozes inhabiting the untamed basin of Un'Goro Crater remain relatively isolated from outside corruption, making them an ideal scientific standard for Ironforge's inquiring minds.

aliases: who needs filled pure sample jar
faq.answer: Laris Geardawdle, a gnomish researcher stationed in Ironforge, seeks these pure jars to continue his ongoing study of Azeroth's ooze populations.

faq.q: Why does Laris need pure ooze instead of tainted ooze?
faq.answer: Laris realized that slimes rapidly adapt and absorb the properties of their surrounding environment, such as the demonic rot in Felwood. To understand the extent and mechanism of that corruption, he requires uncorrupted baseline samples for scientific comparison.

faq.q: Where can pure ooze samples be collected?
aliases: where do i find pure ooze
faq.answer: Pure samples are collected from the glutinous oozes inhabiting the primordial wilderness of Un'Goro Crater, where the flora and fauna remain isolated from external blights.

faq.q: What happens once the samples are delivered to Ironforge?
aliases: what does laris do with them
faq.answer: Laris uses the samples to conduct laboratory tests on adaptation and environmental resilience, rewarding adventurers who brave hazardous wilds to fetch them.

angles.text: Gnomish scholars view field biology through rigorous empirical lenses; contrasting contaminated Felwood slimes against pure Un'Goro specimens exemplifies standard academic method.
Alliance explorers heading into extreme territories like Un'Goro Crater provide vital natural history data back to scholars stationed safely in Ironforge.
